headlines.title: Jalen Green scores 25 and Devin Booker adds 22 to help the Suns top the Pelicans 123-119 in OT
headlines.desc: — Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans, 123-119 in overtime on Monday night.

headlines.title: Kevin Durant scores 32 to power Rockets past Clippers 116-104
headlines.desc: — Kevin Durant scored 32 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each had 20 to lead the Houston Rockets to a 116-104 win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night.

headlines.desc: — Jaden McDaniels scored a career-best 34 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves routed the Brooklyn Nets 142-116 on Monday night.

headlines.title: Herro scores 32 points, Turner adds 27 as Bucks beat Raptors 116-111 to snap 13-game losing streak
headlines.desc: — Tyler Herro scored 32 points, Myles Turner fouled out with a season-high 27 and the Milwaukee Bucks snapped a 13-game losing streak by beating the Toronto Raptors 116-111 on Monday night.
